title: Operating Systems
description: Core computer science fundamentals: process management, memory virtualisation, concurrency, I/O, and file systems.

nodes.title: OS Architecture & Bootstrapping
nodes.description: Kernel architectures, dual-mode execution, system calls, interrupt handling, and boot process.

children.title: Kernel Modes & System Calls
children.description: User mode vs Kernel mode, trap handlers, POSIX system call interface.

children.title: Interrupts & Dual Mode Execution
children.description: Hardware and software interrupts, interrupt vector tables, context switching.

nodes.title: Process & Thread Management
nodes.description: Process Control Blocks (PCB), thread models, CPU scheduling algorithms, and process state transitions.

children.title: Process Control Block (PCB) & States
children.description: Process creation (fork/exec), PCB fields, states (Ready, Running, Waiting, Terminated).

children.title: CPU Scheduling Algorithms
children.description: FCFS, SJF, Round Robin, Priority, and Multi-level Queue CPU schedulers.

children.title: Threads & Concurrency Models
children.description: User-level vs Kernel-level threads, POSIX pthreads, thread pools.

nodes.title: Synchronization & Deadlocks
nodes.description: Critical section problem, mutexes, semaphores, Banker's algorithm, and deadlock handling.

children.title: Mutexes & Semaphores
children.description: Race conditions, atomic instructions (TestAndSet), binary and counting semaphores.

children.title: Deadlock Detection & Prevention
children.description: 4 Coffman deadlock conditions, resource allocation graphs, Banker's avoidance algorithm.

nodes.title: Memory Management & Virtual Memory
nodes.description: Paging, segmentation, TLB caching, page replacement algorithms, and thrashing.

children.title: Paging & Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB)
children.description: Page tables, multi-level paging, page faults, virtual-to-physical address translation.

children.title: Page Replacement Algorithms
children.description: FIFO, Optimal, LRU, LFU, and Clock page replacement strategies.
